3407035.name: Chabad of Altamonte Springs
3407035.note: Heritage Florida Jewish News, 24 March 2017 ('Meet the new rabbi in town'): Rabbi Mendy Bronstein, formerly youth director at The Shul in Milwaukee, and his wife 'arrived in Altamonte Springs last September' (2016); Shabbat dinners and services at their home. IRS: 'Chabad Of Altamonte Springs Inc', exempt from Dec 2016. A new Chabad Jewish Center opened in Dec 2019.

3612343.name: Chabad of Downtown Orlando
3612343.note: Heritage Florida Jewish News, 31 July 2015: 'Rabbi Levik Dubov recently opened Chabad of Downtown for young professionals.' ('Recently': 2015, perhaps late 2014.)

118352.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Wellington
118352.note: Town-Crier (1 Feb 2013, its 'Bar Mitzvah'): 'Chabad is celebrating 13 years of reaching out to the community'; Rabbi Mendy Muskal: 'Within six weeks of arrival, we already had a group of people for a High Holiday get-together'. Thirteen full years by Feb 2013 and an arrival just before the High Holidays give summer 1999 (2000 if the 13 years were not yet complete). Wellington the Magazine (1 Dec 2025): the Muskals have been in Wellington 'for more than 25 years', moving from Kentucky. IRS: 'Chabad Lubavitch Of Wellington Inc', exempt from Feb 2002.

1008423.name: Chabad at the University of South Florida
1008423.note: The Diamondback/Mitzpeh (University of Maryland, 29 Sept 2025): Rabbi Pinny Backman 'and his family helped out for two years before moving to the University of South Florida in 2009'; he and his wife Chava direct Chabad at USF. IRS: 'Chabad At Usf Inc', exempt from Sept 2014.

937893.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Ocala, The Villages and Tri County
937893.note: 2009, from two Chabad.org reports on Rabbi Yossi and Chanie Hecht's Chabad-Lubavitch Jewish Center of Marion County: 'Ocala saw its first Orthodox synagogue just last fall' (6 June 2010, so fall 2009) and 'Ocala's aging Jewish community got its first permanent Chabad House a year-and-a-half ago' (14 Nov 2010, so about spring 2009). The center later moved from Ocala toward The Villages (JTA; now in Oxford). IRS: 'Chabad Lubavitch Jewish Center Of Marion County Inc', exempt from Sept 2010.

earlier.where: Ocala (Chabad-Lubavitch Jewish Center of Marion County)

994623.name: Chabad Spanish Center
994623.note: CrownHeights.info (19 Dec 2012): 'The Habbad Spanish Center has been serving the community of Coral Springs for the past seven years' (count back: about 2005); Rabbi Mordechai Lichy, about 200 members; an offshoot of Chabad of Coral Springs, at 1819 N University Dr.

1479894.name: Chabad of West Davie
1479894.note: Its own site: 'since founding Chabad of West Davie in 2014 Rabbi Mendel and Mushky Spalter' (he was ordained in 2011). IRS: 'Chabad Lubavitch Of West Davie Inc', exempt from Dec 2015. (The chabad.org listing number is from about 2011, perhaps reused.)

1011128.name: Camp Gan Israel Florida Overnight Camp
1011128.note: Parkland Talk (11 Dec 2023): 'According to Biston, Chabad has been organizing overnight camps in Central Florida since 1978 by renting facilities', then its own site in Lake Worth, and a 100-acre site in Groveland bought in 2023. Sun-Sentinel (CrownHeights.info, 7 Jan 2014): the new South Florida Jewish Retreat Center in Lake Worth, on the grounds of Gold Coast Camp; Rabbi Yosef Biston: 'I've been on the lookout for a campsite in this area for over 10 years'. (Rabbi Avraham Korf dated Chabad of Florida's first Gan Israel overnight camp, in DeLand, to 1963.)

earlier.where: rented camp facilities in Central Florida
the South Florida Jewish Retreat Center, Lake Worth (Gold Coast Camp grounds)
